name: Hansika Krishna
bio:
Hansika Krishna (born September 30, 2005) is an Indian actress and social media personality who predominantly works in Malayalam cinema. She comes from a film background, with her father Krishna Kumar being an actor turned politician. Her mother Sindhu Krishna is an entrepreneur who runs an advertising agency. She has three elder sisters, Ahaana Krishna, Ishaani Krishna and Diya Krishna, who are all popular internet personalities and have also appeared in a few movies

Hansika made her acting debut in 2019 with the Malayalam romantic drama Luca, directed by Arun Bose and starring Tovino Thomas and Ahaana Krishna. She played the younger version of Niharika Banerjee, a character portrayed by her elder sister Ahaana

Apart from acting, Hansika has built a significant social media following through Instagram and YouTube, where she shares content related to fashion, lifestyle, travel and dance. She has gradually established herself as a popular digital creator among Malayalam audiences

credits.title: Luca
credits.overview: Luca is a highly talented artist who creates magic out of scraps. Niharika, a researcher in industrial chemistry enters his life to make it more colourful. Will they make it together?
